name: Self Pity
overview: Scripture addresses self pity by encouraging believers to seek joy and strength through God's salvation and Spirit, as seen in Psalms 51:12 and Philippians 4:13. A broken spirit is contrasted with a merry heart that brings healing, highlighting the spiritual and physical harm of dwelling in despair (Proverbs 17:22). Jesus invites those who are burdened to come to Him for rest, emphasizing reliance on Him rather than surrender to self-pity (Matthew 11:28). Believers are called to renew their minds and find contentment in God's provision, trusting in His promise never to forsake them (Romans 12:2; Hebrews 13:5).
